samples.catalog_sha256_policy: evaluator supplies the catalog SHA-256 in verification_policy; missing/mismatch => NOT_RUN

notes: PASS is only an enabling input; the maintainer stays off until the user enables it.
A missing gate file, a sample-count shortfall or a catalog SHA mismatch is NOT_RUN, never a default PASS.
Thresholds change only with a new contract revision and the same shared fixtures.
